t: This is a terrace of houses, numbers 14 to 17, with their original railings still attached, in Camden. They were designed by Nicholas Barbon. Barbon was an English physician, real estate developer and financier. He is regarded as one of the first economists, and he introduced several key innovations in financial markets and insurance. So the man behind these houses was a property developer who also helped shape how money and risk were thought about. Look at the railings and the line of the frontage as you pass.
